capabilities: Connect a GitHub repository folder to a vault folder
Merge and review conflicting text changes
Generate a GitHub Markdown reading view
extras: Not yet in the Obsidian community directory, so it must be installed manually; requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or newer. Pre-release: desktop and mobile installation checks are still pending. Periodic sync, not real-time collaboration. Snapshots capture supported notes across the entire vault, so review the file list before saving to a public repository; the fixed safety filter cannot catch every secret written inside an ordinary note. Per-connection limits: 100 MB and 20,000 files, with an adjustable 1-25 MB per-file cap.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open a GitHub repository folder, edit it with the native editor, and keep it synced without installing Git.

relations.evidence: Connect an existing GitHub repository, branch, and subfolder to a new or existing vault folder.

summary: GitHub sync plugin that connects a repository subtree to a vault folder, syncs notes offline without Git, and exports standalone vault snapshots.
